Chhath 2026: Ranchi men ugte sury ko arghy dekar samapt huaa chhath mahaparv, ghat pahunche hajaron log
Rajdhani ranchi men ugte sury ko arghy dene ke sath hi char divsiy chhath mahaparv ka samapan ho gaya. subah ki pahli kiran ke sath vratiyon ne bhagvan sury ko arghy arpit kar parivar ki sukh-samriddhi aur khushhali ki kamna ki. is pavan avsar par ranchi ke vibhinn chhath ghaton par hajaron shraddhaluon ki bhir umri. ghaton par bhakti, aastha aur utsah ka adbhut sangam dekhne ko mila. chhathi maeeya ke jaykaron se pura mahaul bhaktimay ho gaya.
